ai_summary: AU Small Finance Bank reported strong provisional results for Q2 FY27, with total deposits growing robustly by 28.6% year-on-year and the gross loan portfolio expanding by 25.1% year-on-year. The bank also achieved a healthier funding mix, as indicated by an improved CASA ratio of 29.5%, though it significantly reduced its securitized/assigned portfolio. Investors should note these positive figures are preliminary and subject to final review and approval by the Audit Committee, Board, and Statutory Auditors.
